name: story-parts
title: Story parts
description: Shared grids, captions, type specimens, swatches, prompt fields, and reveal timing for dot animations.
usage: Building a new story that sits beside these (a page hero story, a style guide picture or a prompt being typed), so it lines up with the ones already drawn.
avoid: Hex colors in a story (use brand tokens through canvasColor)

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
